help.zapret.title: Load Zapret
help.zapret.body: Enables the Zapret section: the program downloads the latest version from GitHub, keeps it updated and starts it with the “Zapret” button in the header (right-click it for Zapret settings). Bypasses blocking of Discord and YouTube without a VPN.
help.zapret.plus: everything in one place, no fiddling with archives and .bat files
help.zapret.minus: Zapret intercepts network traffic (WinDivert driver): an antivirus may complain, and a VPN may conflict with it
help.z_toggle.title: Turning Zapret on
help.z_toggle.body: Starts or stops the blocking bypass. While it runs, the winws.exe process is visible in Task Manager.
help.z_restart.title: Restart
help.z_restart.body: Zapret reads the strategy, lists and filters only at startup. After any changes, restart it for them to take effect.
help.z_strategy.title: Strategy
help.z_strategy.body:
A set of tricks Zapret uses to get around your ISP's equipment. Each ISP needs something different, there is no universal one — you have to pick. To the right of the name you can see the test result: how many sites opened.
general — the main one: splits the request into parts and adds fake packets, start with it. ALT, ALT2 … — other combinations of the same tricks. FAKE TLS AUTO — sends a fake “handshake” with the google.com address, works where the simple ones fail. SIMPLE FAKE — fake packets only, less likely to break other sites. EXP — experimental.
help.z_strategy.plus: you can find a working option for yourself
help.z_strategy.minus: strategies stop working over time — then you need another one (fastest is the “Strategy test” tab)
help.z_game.title: Game filter
help.z_game.body: Extends the bypass beyond websites to games and programs that use ports above 1023. Usually UDP is needed for voice chats and online games, TCP for launchers and downloads.
help.z_game.plus: helps games and services that would otherwise be blocked
help.z_game.minus: more traffic goes through the bypass: delays and glitches are possible. If something breaks, turn the filter off
help.z_ports.title: Game filter ports
help.z_ports.body: Which ports to process. “All ports” is 1024–65535. “Without RTMP” excludes port 1935: needed if the bypass breaks broadcasts (streams).
help.z_ports_edit.title: Custom ports
help.z_ports_edit.body: Reveals TCP and UDP port fields under this row — your own set instead of “All ports” / “Without RTMP”. The fields have hints with examples.
help.z_ipset.title: IP filter (IPSet)
help.z_ipset.body: A list of IP addresses (Cloudflare, game servers, etc.) for which the bypass is applied regardless of domain.
help.z_ipset.plus: covers services that can't be detected by site name
help.z_ipset.minus: “All IPs” mode can break many sites — don't keep it on permanently. If something stops opening, set it to “Off”
help.z_ipset_upd.title: Update IP list
help.z_ipset_upd.body: Downloads a fresh address list from GitHub. Makes sense in “From list” mode.
help.z_autoupd.title: Auto-update
help.z_autoupd.body: Every few hours the program checks GitHub and installs a new Zapret version. Your lists and settings are kept.
help.z_autoupd.plus: strategies get adjusted for new blocks
help.z_autoupd.minus: after an update a strategy may behave differently — if something breaks, run the test
help.z_test.title: Strategy test
help.z_test.body: Runs each strategy in turn and checks whether Discord, YouTube and Google open. A result of “5/8” is how many sites opened. The “Without bypass” row shows how everything opens without Zapret.
help.z_test.plus: finds a working strategy in a couple of minutes
help.z_test.minus: the internet may flicker during the test; if Zapret was running, it turns on again after the test
help.l_general.title: Custom domains to bypass
help.l_general.body: Sites that need extra bypassing. “Edit” expands the list right here — the “?” hint at the editor shows what to write and how.
help.l_exclude.title: Excluded domains
help.l_exclude.body: Sites Zapret must not touch, even if they are in the general lists. Handy if a site stopped opening because of the bypass. “Edit” expands the list right here.
help.l_ipex.title: IP exclusions
help.l_ipex.body: IP addresses and subnets that should not be processed. “Edit” expands the list right here — the “?” hint at the editor shows examples.
help.l_builtin.title: Built-in lists
help.l_builtin.body: Domain and IP lists that ship with Zapret. You shouldn't edit them: changes are lost on update. Make your own additions in the lists above.
help.l_apply.title: Apply changes
help.l_apply.body: Zapret reads the lists only at startup, so it needs a restart after edits.
help.l_hosts.title: hosts file
help.l_hosts.body: The Windows system “address book”: which site to look up at which address. Zapret's authors advise adding the addresses for Discord voice chat and Telegram web there.
help.l_hosts.plus: fixes connecting to Discord voice chat
help.l_hosts.minus: edits a system file (administrator rights required). The program adds a separate block — you can remove it with the “Remove entries” button
help.d_diag.title: Diagnostics
help.d_diag.body: Looks for typical reasons Zapret doesn't work: antivirus, Base Filtering Engine service, conflicting programs (Killer, SmartByte, Check Point, AdGuard), VPN, proxy, Cyrillic letters in the path. Red — must be fixed, yellow — recommended.
help.d_cache.title: Discord cache
help.d_cache.body: Deletes Discord's temporary files (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache). Helps if Discord suddenly stopped working after a strategy change. Your account and messages are not affected.
help.d_cache.minus: Discord will close, and the first launch will take a bit longer
help.d_defender.title: Defender exclusions
help.d_defender.body: Windows Defender may mistake the WinDivert driver for a “potentially unwanted application” and delete Zapret's files. An exclusion prevents this.
help.d_defender.minus: Defender will stop scanning this folder. The program does not add the exclusion itself — you do it in “Windows Security”. If you have a different antivirus, add the folder to its exclusions
help.d_log.title: winws.exe log
help.d_log.body: The last output of winws.exe. If Zapret failed to start, the reason is written here.
help.x_service.title: Windows service
help.x_service.body: Installs Zapret as a service: it starts with Windows and works even without this program.
help.x_service.minus: while the service is installed, manual start and the strategy test are unavailable, and changing settings reinstalls the service
help.x_fakes.title: Fake packets
help.x_fakes.body: A “fake” is a prepared decoy packet that Zapret sends along with the real one to confuse your ISP's equipment. Replace them only if Discord voice won't connect or games don't work — try the options with the arrows, then restart.
help.x_fake_discord.title: Fake for Discord
help.x_fake_game.title: Fake for games
help.x_fake_game.body: Used by the game filter (UDP). Works only if the game filter is on.
help.x_folder.title: Zapret folder
help.x_folder.body: This is where Zapret's files live: strategies (.bat), lists and the winws.exe program.
help.strategy.fake_tls_auto.body: Sends a fake “handshake” with the address www.google.com (random each time) and splits the real request. Works where simple strategies fail.
help.strategy.simple_fake.body: Fake packets only, without splitting the request. The lightest: less likely to break unrelated sites, but doesn't suit every ISP.
help.strategy.exp.body: An experimental option: a mix of faking and splitting packets. May work where others don't, but is less tested than the rest.
help.strategy.alt.body: A variant of the main strategy: a different mix of faking and splitting packets. If the main one doesn't work with your ISP, try ALT, ALT2 … ALT13 — or run the “Strategy test”.
help.strategy.general.body: The main strategy: splits the request into parts and adds fake packets. Start with it.
help.tm_net.title: Network
help.tm_net.body: How much the program is downloading and uploading right now. Per program, Windows without special tools shows only TCP connections, so voice calls, games and QUIC video (part of YouTube) may not be visible here. The overall speed at the top is accurate, across all adapters.
help.tm_end.title: End task
help.tm_end.body: Immediately closes the selected program with all its processes. Unsaved data in it will be lost.
help.tm_windows.title: Windows Task Manager
help.tm_windows.body: Opens the full system Task Manager: services, startup, performance and Windows processes.

uninstall.zapret.title: Turn off and remove Zapret?
uninstall.zapret.text: Zapret will be stopped and removed completely: the Windows service, the WinDivert driver, files ({0}) along with its domain lists, entries in the hosts file and its settings. Turn “Load Zapret” on again and it will be downloaded anew. If you added a Defender exclusion, remove it yourself in “Windows Security”.
uninstall.app.title: Uninstall the program?
uninstall.app.text:
The program will close, and the desktop icons and HDR will be restored as they were. The following will be removed: autostart, the entry in “Apps”, Zapret with everything it installed (service, driver, hosts), the mini browser cache and the program file itself:
{0}

help.glass.title: Glass
help.glass.body:
The background under the panel is drawn by Windows itself on the GPU — no screenshots, the panel is visible in screen recordings, and the blur doesn't go away when you click elsewhere.
The blur is standard, as in Windows itself.
Darkening is a dark layer on top: 0% — no darkening.
help.close.title: Closing the panel
help.close.body: Clicking outside the panel does not close it. You can choose “To the corner” — then the panel shrinks into a small tile with the HDR, Zapret, Task Manager and mini browser buttons. You can drag the tile with the mouse, “Expand” brings the panel back. The shortcut always hides the panel completely. Esc in Settings goes a step back, on the desktop it hides the panel.
help.close.plus: “To the corner” — buttons at hand, and the desktop stays out of the way
help.games.title: Fullscreen games
help.games.body: The panel opens on top of the game. If the game is in exclusive fullscreen mode, Windows doesn't allow another window above it — so the program minimizes the game and restores it after the panel closes. The program does not switch the game to windowed mode.
help.games.minus: Some games take long to restore or reset their graphics — then switch the game to “Borderless windowed” in its settings
help.pip.title: Mini browser
help.pip.body:
A window above all programs and games: watch a video, a stream, or keep a site at hand. Runs on the Edge engine (WebView2), which is already in Windows.
In normal mode the window doesn't take focus and lets clicks through. Interaction mode (keyboard shortcut) — the window accepts mouse and keyboard, a bar with the address and favorites appears, and the edges can be dragged. Esc works like in a regular browser; clicking outside the window exits the mode, and focus goes to where you clicked.
help.pip.plus: pause, seek and volume can be controlled with shortcuts right from a game
help.pip.minus: the browser uses memory while the window is open (freed when the program is closed)

help.tgproxy.title: Telegram proxy
help.tgproxy.body:
A local MTProto proxy, TG WS Proxy (github.com/Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy): Telegram Desktop connects to it, and it passes traffic to Telegram's servers over WebSocket — so both messages and media work without a VPN. No third-party servers needed.
The proxy has its own tray icon — its menu works too.
help.tgproxy.plus: no VPN needed; changes nothing in the system
help.tgproxy.minus: only for Telegram Desktop on this computer. If your network has IPv6, Telegram may try to connect over it bypassing the proxy — then turn off “Use IPv6” in Telegram (Settings → Advanced → Connection type)

help.takeover.title: Take shortcuts over from Windows
help.takeover.body: Windows keeps some shortcuts for itself: Win+C opens search or Copilot, and the usual method (RegisterHotKey) doesn't receive them. If turned on, the program listens to the keyboard and intercepts the chosen shortcut itself — the Windows window will no longer open for it.
help.takeover.minus: this is a keyboard hook — some antivirus programs are wary of such software. The program lets all keys through except the chosen shortcut and doesn't pass them anywhere

help.e_general.title: Custom domains — what to write here
help.e_general.body:
One domain per line, without https:// and without a path. Subdomains are covered automatically: youtube.com covers both www.youtube.com and m.youtube.com. Lines starting with # are comments, Zapret skips them.
Examples:
youtube.com
discord.com
discord.gg
rutracker.org
You can paste a whole link (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…) — only youtube.com will remain on save. Saving will restart Zapret if it's on.
help.e_exclude.title: Excluded domains — what to write here
help.e_exclude.body:
Sites Zapret must not touch, even if they are in the general lists. Handy if a site stopped opening or working because of the bypass. Same format: one domain per line, subdomains are covered automatically.
Examples:
sberbank.ru
gosuslugi.ru
my-company-portal.com
Saving will restart Zapret if it's on.
help.e_ipex.title: IP exclusions — what to write here
help.e_ipex.body:
Addresses Zapret must not process: one per line — an address, a subnet (with /) or a range (with a hyphen). Both IPv4 and IPv6 work.
Examples:
192.168.1.0/24 — the whole home network
10.0.0.5 — a single address
203.0.113.10-203.0.113.20 — a range
2001:db8::/32 — an IPv6 subnet
Saving will restart Zapret if it's on.
help.e_tcp.title: TCP ports
help.e_tcp.body:
Which TCP ports the game filter processes. Numbers from 1 to 65535 separated by commas, ranges with a hyphen, no spaces.
Examples:
1024-65535 — all ports above 1023
1024-1934,1936-65535 — all except 1935 (RTMP: otherwise broadcasts break)
27015-27050 — Source engine games (CS2, Dota 2)
help.e_udp.title: UDP ports
help.e_udp.body:
Which UDP ports the game filter processes (voice, game traffic). Same format as TCP: numbers separated by commas, ranges with a hyphen, no spaces.
Examples:
1024-65535 — all ports above 1023
50000-65535 — Discord voice chats
27000-27100 — Steam
